summary: Each requested iteration exchanges vector halo values and computes both interior and boundary rows. The two row lists partition all local rows, rather than skipping halo-dependent work.

source_evidence.claim: Nonzero-balanced row boundaries cover [0,numRows). After column remapping, each local row is assigned exactly one list. Both lists run complete CSR arithmetic on every iteration of the unmodified CLI bound, separated by MPI_Waitall.

compiled_evidence.claim: The compiled interior and boundary multiply/add loops at af0a/af12 and afc9/afd1 are enclosed by the outer b004->ace0 repetition backedge. MPI_Waitall remains between the two sets of rows.
